title: Report: GTA 6 Map Leaks via Collector's Box Sold Early at Selfridges UK
description: A Grand Theft Auto VI Collector's Edition box was reportedly sold early at a Selfridges store in Manchester, revealing the game's official map ahead of the November 19 release. Photos shared on social media show the folded map displaying new location names such as Southwind and Pelican Valley.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Map Leaks Early via Collector's Box at Selfridges UK
socialHook: GTA 6's map has leaked early after a Collector's Edition box was sold at Selfridges Manchester, revealing new locations.

sections.heading: Collector's Box Sold Early at Selfridges Manchester
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL reports that a Grand Theft Auto VI Collector's Box was on sale at the Selfridges Manchester Exchange Square store on November 12, 2026, and has since been sold. The box includes an official folded map that was visible in the display, and a photo shared by Instagram user @GazzaMontana shows the map partially unfolded, revealing several in‑game location names.

VGC corroborates the leak, noting that the clearest images came from an Instagram account that has since been deleted, but multiple sources have shared similar photos of the folded map. The outlet adds that the Collector's Edition is not being sold at Selfridges; the display was part of a partnership with Rockstar Games, and the edition will ship in time for the November 19 launch.

sections.heading: New Locations Revealed on Leaked Map
paragraphs: The leaked map shows new area names including Southwind and Pelican Valley, which appear to be smaller settlements and natural areas outside Vice City. RockstarINTEL notes that the last two names on the map are not completely clear in the photos, so their exact spelling remains uncertain.

VGC observes that the map is highly stylised and may represent only one side of a double‑sided insert. No other sources have yet shared images of a potential reverse side, so the full extent of the map is still unknown.

sections.heading: Rockstar Has Not Officially Released the Map
paragraphs: Rockstar Games has not publicly shared the full Collector's Edition map. With the game's release date approaching on November 19, 2026, fans may not have to wait much longer for an official reveal. Both publications caution that the leaked images are from a retail display error and do not constitute an official announcement.
